sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% concentration for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).

-During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Light and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 10%.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Deal magic damage (Dark) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Physical Penalty for 60 seconds with a success value of 150.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Magic Penalty for 60 seconds with a success value of 150.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Paralysis and Psychological Contamination Resistance Up by 70

[Void Claw Fatewoven] John Doe or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
